title: When extremes compound
description: Heatwaves, droughts and atmospheric blocking do not occur in isolation. My research explores how these phenomena evolve and intersect with exposure and vulnerability.

title: Distant oceans. Local consequences.
description: Investigating teleconnections, the South Atlantic Convergence Zone and climate indices to understand rainfall variability and climate extremes across Brazil.

title: From climate scenarios to human realities
description: The LAMMOC/UFF socio-environmental vulnerability project, active since 2023, combines Earth system modeling and social data to map exposure to climate extremes in Brazil. Its planned methods include NCAR/CESM 2.0, RCESM, CMIP6 scenarios, hydrological modeling and AI.

title: Intelligence that reaches practice
description: Connecting machine learning, computer vision and AI agents with environmental problems: from CNN-GRU crop-yield modeling to conversational access to forecast and observation APIs.
